description: ClimateSERV Python is a client for the SERVIR ClimateSERV API. Its README documents pip and conda installation and requests for time-series CSV, summary statistics and raster or NetCDF outputs from supported climate datasets. Users choose a variable, region and time interval; outputs are the provider's weather or environmental series and files at their native resolution. Geographic coverage is the set of regions available through ClimateSERV, not a guarantee of global observations. The README states MIT licensing for this client even though GitHub did not classify an SPDX licence; provider data terms are separate. A limitation is that endpoint and dataset-number changes can break old scripts, and G7 did not query live data. The client can prepare rainfall or vegetation context for agriculture, flood and road-access simulations. The related ERA5 catalogue record is a possible climate source but not this API wrapper. No raster or package archive was downloaded.
name: ClimateSERV Python API client
notes: G7 G7-2012. Prepared draft only. Metadata review on 2026-09-28; no models, data or archives downloaded. Related-resource comparisons are reviewer mappings, not tested interoperability.
